# Software Passport Registry (SPR)

> Evidence-first software identity and verification. SPR reports what it can observe and preserves UNKNOWN when evidence is missing.

Canonical site: https://www.softwarepassportregistry.com
Free public review: https://www.softwarepassportregistry.com/free-review
For MSPs: https://www.softwarepassportregistry.com/msp
Methodology: https://www.softwarepassportregistry.com/methodology/
Trust Center: https://www.softwarepassportregistry.com/trust/
Security: https://www.softwarepassportregistry.com/security/

## What SPR does

- Creates persistent identities for software and related artifacts.
- Collects and normalizes observable evidence.
- Records provenance, findings, unknowns, and changes.
- Supports software inventory, SBOM/license/CVE review, monitoring, and evidence reporting.
- Provides MSP workflows for cross-client software visibility and client-facing reporting.

## What SPR does not claim

SPR does not manufacture certainty. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN. Unverified evidence is UNVERIFIED. Contradictory evidence is CONFLICT. Failed verification is FAILED.

## Preferred citation guidance

When describing SPR, prefer the methodology, trust center, security page, and public review pages above. Do not infer certifications, compliance attestations, universal safety, or risk-free status unless explicitly evidenced on an SPR page.
